From 93bdc0eb0b4bb5e7094fd4a95f4a394e4a927e09 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Gustavo A. R. Silva" <gustavo@embeddedor.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Dec 2019 09:05:32 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] can: tcan4x5x: tcan4x5x_parse_config(): fix inconsistent
 IS_ERR and PTR_ERR

Fix inconsistent IS_ERR and PTR_ERR in tcan4x5x_parse_config().

The proper pointer to be passed as argument is tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio.

This bug was detected with the help of Coccinelle.

Fixes: 2de497356955 ("can: tcan45x: Make wake-up GPIO an optional GPIO")
Signed-off-by: Gustavo A. R. Silva <gustavo@embeddedor.com>
Acked-by: Dan Murphy <dmurphy@ti.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Kleine-Budde <mkl@pengutronix.de>

diff --git a/drivers/net/can/m_can/tcan4x5x.c b/drivers/net/can/m_can/tcan4x5x.c
index a413e7548546..eacd428e07e9 100644
--- a/drivers/net/can/m_can/tcan4x5x.c
+++ b/drivers/net/can/m_can/tcan4x5x.c
@@ -387,7 +387,7 @@ static int tcan4x5x_parse_config(struct m_can_classdev *cdev)
 	tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio = devm_gpiod_get(cdev->dev, "device-wake",
 						    GPIOD_OUT_HIGH);
 	if (IS_ERR(tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio)) {
-		if (PTR_ERR(tcan4x5x->power) == -EPROBE_DEFER)
+		if (PTR_ERR(tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio) == -EPROBE_DEFER)
 			return -EPROBE_DEFER;
 
 		tcan4x5x_disable_wake(cdev);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/can/m_can/tcan4x5x.c`**
- The line checking for the error condition of `device_wake_gpio` was modified. 
- The original code used `PTR_ERR(tcan4x5x->power)` to check for the `-EPROBE_DEFER` condition.
- The modified code now correctly uses `PTR_ERR(tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio)` for this check.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug related to inconsistent error handling in the `tcan4x5x_parse_config()` function. 
- The change ensures that the correct pointer (`device_wake_gpio`) is used when checking for errors, which aligns with the intended functionality of the code. 
- This fix is linked to a previous commit (identified by the hash `2de497356955`) that made the wake-up GPIO optional, indicating that the issue arose from changes made in that earlier commit.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (IS_ERR(tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio)) {
    if (PTR_ERR(tcan4x5x->power) == -EPROBE_DEFER)
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the error handling logic incorrectly checks the pointer `tcan4x5x->power` instead of `tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio`. This leads to inconsistent error handling, as the status of the wake-up GPIO is not accurately reflected, potentially causing the system to misinterpret the error condition.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (PTR_ERR(tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio) == -EPROBE_DEFER)
```
Reason:
The fix updates the error handling logic to correctly check the pointer `tcan4x5x->device_wake_gpio`. This ensures that the error condition accurately reflects the status of the relevant GPIO for wake-up functionality, leading to consistent and correct error handling in the `tcan4x5x_parse_config()` function.
